entities.name: Full-screen or modal browser pop-up titled "Windows Defender Alert" or "Microsoft Security Essentials"
Message stating "Your computer is infected with viruses and spyware. Call support now at 1-800-XXX-XXXX"
Fake scan progress bar showing dozens of threats detected
Inability to close the window via the usual X button; clicking anywhere may trigger a download prompt
Visiting compromised or malicious websites that serve malvertising ads
Clicking on deceptive links in phishing emails or social media posts
Outdated browser extensions or plugins that inject unwanted scripts
Redirects from legitimate sites via hijacked ad networks
Legitimate Defender alerts appear inside the Windows Security app, not inside a browser window, and do not include a phone number to call
Do not call the phone number shown in the pop-up and do not download any offered software

If possible, close the browser tab or window by right-clicking the browser icon on the taskbar and selecting "Close window"; if blocked, press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager, locate the browser process (chrome.exe, msedge.exe, or safari.exe), select it, and click "End task"
